learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to learn how to throw accurately to a target, catch balls safely from a distance, and play awesome passing games with your friends!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Before you throw, always look straight at your target. Point your arm where you want the ball to go, step forward with your opposite foot, and let it fly with power!
Keep your eyes on the ball as it zooms toward you. Make a big basket shape with your hands and gently hug the ball into your chest so it stays safe and does not bounce away.
Passing means sharing the ball with your teammates to keep the game moving fast! Always call out your friend's name loudly before you throw so they are ready to catch it safely.

fun_activity.title: ⚽ The Magic Target Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a big circle on an outside wall using chalk. Take 5 giant steps back and try to throw a soft ball right into the middle! Can you hit the target and catch the bounce 10 times in a row?

quick_recap: ⭐ Always keep your eyes glued to the target when you throw the ball.
⭐ Use both hands to make a soft basket to catch the ball safely.
⭐ Teamwork is key! Call your teammate's name before passing so everyone stays alert.
